name: Olympus Mons
origin: Mount Olympus, home of Greek gods; tallest planetary volcano.

name: Ascraeus Mons
origin: Northernmost of the Tharsis Montes.

name: Pavonis Mons
origin: Central shield volcano of Tharsis Montes.

name: Arsia Mons
origin: Southernmost of the Tharsis Montes.

name: Elysium Mons
origin: Volcanic peak in Elysium Planitia.

name: Alba Mons
origin: Broadest volcanic shield on Mars.

name: Valles Marineris
origin: Grand canyon system of Mars; Mariner 9 mission.

name: Kasei Valles
origin: Japanese word for Mars; giant outflow channel.

name: Ares Vallis
origin: Greek god of war; Pathfinder landing site.

name: Mawrth Vallis
origin: Welsh word for Mars; clay-rich ancient outflow.

name: Gale Crater
origin: Walter F. Gale, Australian astronomer; MSL Curiosity site.

name: Jezero Crater
origin: Town in Bosnia and Herzegovina; Mars 2020 Perseverance site.

name: Gusev Crater
origin: Matvey Gusev, Russian astronomer; MER Spirit site.

name: Victoria Crater
origin: Magellan's ship; explored by Opportunity rover.

name: Endeavour Crater
origin: HMS Endeavour; Opportunity rover destination.

name: Korolev Crater
origin: Sergei Korolev, Soviet rocket engineer; filled with permanent water ice.

name: Schiaparelli Crater
origin: Giovanni Schiaparelli, Italian astronomer.

name: Hellas Planitia
origin: Classical name for Greece; deepest impact basin on Mars.

name: Argyre Planitia
origin: Mythical silver island in the Indian Ocean.

name: Isidis Planitia
origin: Egyptian goddess Isis.

name: Utopia Planitia
origin: Nowhere Land; Viking 2 and Zhurong landing site.

name: Acidalia Planitia
origin: Mythological fountain of Venus.

name: Elysium Planitia
origin: Elysian Fields in Greek mythology; InSight lander site.

name: Noctis Labyrinthus
origin: Labyrinth of the night; complex valley network at western Valles Marineris.

name: Aram Chaos
origin: Biblical region; collapsed chaotic terrain rich in hematite.

name: Gorgonum Chaos
origin: Mythological Gorgons; source of recent gullies.

name: Hebes Chasma
origin: Hebes, Greek goddess of youth; closed canyon depression.

name: Melas Chasma
origin: Greek for dark; central and deepest segment of Valles Marineris.

name: Planum Boreum
origin: Northern plain; Martian north polar ice cap.

name: Planum Australe
origin: Southern plain; Martian south polar ice cap.

name: Cerberus Fossae
origin: Cerberus from Greek mythology; seismically active fissures detected by InSight.

name: Tycho Crater
origin: Tycho Brahe, Danish astronomer; prominent lunar ray crater.

name: Copernicus Crater
origin: Nicolaus Copernicus, Polish astronomer.

name: Aristarchus Crater
origin: Aristarchus of Samos; brightest feature on the lunar surface.

name: Kepler Crater
origin: Johannes Kepler, German astronomer.

name: Shackleton Crater
origin: Ernest Shackleton, Antarctic explorer; lunar south pole with permanently shadowed regions.

name: Connecting Ridge
origin: High topographic ridge connecting Shackleton and de Gerlache; prime Artemis landing and solar base site.

name: Malapert Massif
origin: 5,000m high lunar mountain; premier site for lunar base communication and solar power with Earth visibility.

name: Haworth Crater
origin: Walter Haworth, British chemist; polar crater hosting extensive cryogenic volatile cold traps.

name: Faustini Crater
origin: Arnaldo Faustini, Italian geographer; high rim illumination adjacent to ice-rich PSRs.

name: de Gerlache Crater
origin: Adrien de Gerlache, Belgian polar explorer; deep polar crater near Shackleton.

name: Nobile Crater
origin: Umberto Nobile, Italian aeronautical engineer; target exploration site for lunar water-ice.

name: Amundsen Crater
origin: Roald Amundsen, Norwegian polar explorer; large complex impact crater near South Pole.

name: Clavius Crater
origin: Christopher Clavius, Jesuit mathematician; one of the largest lunar craters.

name: Mare Tranquillitatis
origin: Sea of Tranquility; Apollo 11 landing site.

name: Mare Imbrium
origin: Sea of Showers; vast lava-flooded impact basin.

name: Mare Serenitatis
origin: Sea of Serenity; Apollo 17 landing site nearby.

name: Oceanus Procellarum
origin: Ocean of Storms; largest lunar mare.

name: Montes Apenninus
origin: Apennine Mountains; border of Mare Imbrium; Apollo 15 landing site.

name: Conamara Chaos
origin: Celtic mythical region; disrupted matrix of floating ice rafts imaged at 9 m/px by NASA Galileo SSI.

name: Pwyll Crater
origin: Welsh Celtic god of the underworld; geologically youthful impact crater with bright rays.

name: Cilix Crater
origin: Brother of Europa in Greek mythology; sharp central-peak crater.

name: Tyre Impact Structure
origin: Ancient Phoenician city where Europa was born; concentric multi-ring impact basin formed in thin ice.

name: Callanish Impact Structure
origin: Place in Scotland known for megalithic stone circle; multi-ring concentric fracture zone.

name: Agenor Linea
origin: Father of Europa; prominent bright linear ridge system shaped by diurnal tidal flexing.

name: Astypalaea Linea
origin: Sister of Europa; prominent strike-slip transform fault cutting through south polar ice.

name: Thera Macula
origin: Greek island of Santorini; low-albedo disrupted chaos depression likely overlying a liquid water lens.

name: Thrace Macula
origin: Historical region in southeast Europe; dark fracture and chaos terrain.

name: Tara Corona
origin: Ancient seat of Irish High Kings; circular volcano-tectonic depression.

name: Rhadamanthys Linea
origin: Son of Europa and Zeus; prominent cycloidal double-ridge lineament.

name: Mannannán Crater
origin: Irish sea god; young central-peak crater with distinct albedo asymmetry.

name: Tegid Crater
origin: Welsh mythological figure; prominent impact basin on Europa leading hemisphere.

name: Taliesin Crater
origin: Welsh Celtic bard; rayed crater with dark ejecta blanket.

name: Morvran Crater
origin: Celtic mythology, son of Tegid; sharp fresh impact crater.

name: Govannan Crater
origin: Welsh god of metalworking; bright rayed impact crater.

name: Maeve Crater
origin: Irish queen of Connacht; northern high-latitude impact depression.

name: Grannos Crater
origin: Celtic god of healing springs; degraded impact basin.

name: Balor Crater
origin: Celtic deity with the venomous eye; northern hemisphere crater.

name: Belus Linea
origin: Brother of Agenor; dark reddish-brown tectonic lineament with double ridge morphology.

name: Minos Linea
origin: Son of Europa and Zeus, King of Crete; northern cycloidal lineament.

name: Cadmus Linea
origin: Brother of Europa, founder of Thebes; prominent strike-slip ridge system.

name: Delphi Linea
origin: Ancient Greek sacred site; high-latitude cycloidal flexure.

name: Pelops Linea
origin: Greek mythological hero; intersecting ridge complex.

name: Libya Linea
origin: Daughter of Epaphus and mother of Agenor; prominent polar ridge.

name: Hippolytus Linea
origin: Greek mythological son of Theseus; curved tidal lineament.

name: Udun Linea
origin: Norse mythological subterranean place; bright tectonic ridge.

name: Tynia Linea
origin: Etruscan supreme god of the sky; intersecting ridge system.

name: Murias Chaos
origin: City of the Tuatha De Danann; extensive disrupted ice-raft terrain.

name: Rathmore Chaos
origin: Irish mythological settlement; thermal disruption matrix.

name: Narberth Chaos
origin: Chief residence of Pwyll in the Mabinogion; ice raft matrix.

name: Castalia Macula
origin: Nymph of the Delphic spring; localized brine upwelling feature.

name: Cyclades Macula
origin: Greek island group; dark albedo cryo-thermal patch.

name: Annwn Regio
origin: Welsh underworld realm; vast leading-hemisphere bright ice terrain.

name: Argadnel Regio
origin: Celtic otherworld earthly paradise; ridged plains terrain.

name: Tara Regio
origin: Seat of Celtic High Kings; extensive trailing-hemisphere disrupted province.

name: Powys Regio
origin: Ancient Welsh kingdom; heavily fractured southern ice plain.

name: Sidon Flexus
origin: Ancient Phoenician city; prominent cycloidal curved cusp formed by diurnal tidal flexing.

name: Delphi Flexus
origin: Sanctuary of Apollo; high-latitude tidal cusp fracture.

name: Caloris Planitia
origin: Latin for 'Plains of Heat'; largest impact basin on Mercury.

name: Rachmaninoff
origin: Sergei Rachmaninoff; peak-ring basin hosting Mercury's lowest elevation.

name: Rembrandt
origin: Rembrandt van Rijn; young southern impact basin with radial graben.

name: Kuiper
origin: Gerard Kuiper; bright rayed crater defining the Kuiperian period.

name: Borealis Planitia
origin: Northern volcanic smooth plains emplaced by flood volcanism.

name: Maxwell Montes
origin: James Clerk Maxwell; highest mountain massif on Venus (~11 km).

name: Maat Mons
origin: Egyptian goddess of truth; tallest shield volcano on Venus with active vent remodeling.

name: Artemis Corona
origin: Greek goddess of the hunt; largest volcano-tectonic corona in the Solar System.

name: Lakshmi Planum
origin: Hindu goddess of prosperity; high plateau in western Ishtar Terra.

name: Diana Chasma
origin: Roman moon goddess; deep rift canyon in Aphrodite Terra.

name: Mead
origin: Margaret Mead; largest impact crater on Venus.

name: Stickney
origin: Chloe Angeline Stickney Hall; 9 km crater dominating Phobos.

name: Hall
origin: Asaph Hall, discoverer of Phobos and Deimos in 1877.

name: Swift
origin: Jonathan Swift, whose 1726 Gulliver's Travels anticipated two Martian moons.

name: Voltaire
origin: French Enlightenment writer whose 1752 Micromegas described two Martian moons.

name: Occator
origin: Roman agricultural deity; hosts bright sodium-carbonate Cerealia & Vinalia Faculae.

name: Ahuna Mons
origin: Sumi Naga harvest festival; 4 km cryovolcanic dome imaged by Dawn.

name: Kerwan
origin: Hopi spirit of sprouting maize; largest confirmed impact basin on Ceres.

name: Haulani
origin: Hawaiian plant goddess; young bright-rayed crater.

name: Rheasilvia
origin: Vestal Virgin mother of Romulus and Remus; giant south-polar basin with 22 km central peak.

name: Marcia
origin: Roman Vestal Virgin; young volatile-pitted crater.

name: Divalia Fossae
origin: Roman festival of Angerona; equatorial graben trough encircling Vesta.

name: Loki Patera
origin: Norse trickster god; largest active volcanic depression and overturning lava lake on Io.

name: Pele
origin: Hawaiian volcano goddess; persistent lava lake with 1,200 km red sulfur plume ring.

name: Tvashtar Paterae
origin: Vedic artisan god; chain of active silicate fire-fountain calderas.

name: Boosaule Montes
origin: Egyptian cavern of Io; tallest non-volcanic tectonic peak on Io (~17.5 km).

name: Galileo Regio
origin: Galileo Galilei; ancient dark heavily cratered icy crust with concentric furrows.

name: Gilgamesh
origin: Sumerian hero king; prominent icy multi-ring impact basin.

name: Uruk Sulcus
origin: Ancient Mesopotamian city; bright tectonically grooved terrain.

name: Valhalla
origin: Odin's hall in Norse mythology; largest multi-ring impact basin in the Solar System.

name: Asgard
origin: Realm of the Norse gods; second-largest concentric ring structure on Callisto.

name: Herschel
origin: William Herschel, discoverer of Mimas in 1789; spans one-third of Mimas' diameter.

name: Baghdad Sulcus
origin: One Thousand and One Nights; south-polar 'Tiger Stripe' venting subsurface ocean plumes.

name: Damascus Sulcus
origin: One Thousand and One Nights; active cryovolcanic 'Tiger Stripe' fracture.

name: Odysseus
origin: Hero of Homer's Odyssey; giant viscously relaxed impact basin.

name: Ithaca Chasma
origin: Island home of Odysseus; 100 km-wide canyon girdling three-quarters of Tethys.

name: Eurotas Chasmata
origin: River of Sparta in the Aeneid; bright ice fault scarps ('wispy terrain').

name: Inktomi
origin: Lakota spider spirit; bright young water-ice ray crater.

name: Kraken Mare
origin: Norse sea monster; largest liquid methane/ethane sea on Titan.

name: Ligeia Mare
origin: Greek Siren; deep methane sea sounded to ~160 m depth by Cassini RADAR.

name: Xanadu
origin: Coleridge's Kubla Khan; radar-bright water-ice highland continent.

name: Selk
origin: Egyptian goddess of knowledge; target impact structure for NASA's Dragonfly rotorcraft.

name: Doom Mons
origin: Tolkien's Mount Doom; putative cryovolcanic edifice next to Sotra Patera.

name: Toledo Montes
origin: Song of Roland; 20 km-tall equatorial mountain ridge spanning Cassini Regio.

name: Turgis
origin: Saracen count in Song of Roland; giant basin with 15 km scarp landslide.

name: Jason
origin: Leader of the Argonauts; largest crater on captured Kuiper Belt moon Phoebe.

name: Monad Regio
origin: Chinese symbol of duality; smooth cryovolcanic resurfaced plains.

name: Bubembe Regio
origin: Baganda island sacred to Mukasa; classic 'cantaloupe terrain' diapiric crust.

name: Mazomba
origin: Chaga mythological giant fish; largest confirmed impact crater on Triton.

name: Sputnik Planitia
origin: Sputnik 1; convecting solid nitrogen-ice glacier basin forming Tombaugh Regio's western lobe.

name: Wright Mons
origin: Orville and Wilbur Wright; 4 km-high putative water-ice cryovolcano.

name: Tenzing Montes
origin: Tenzing Norgay; 6.2 km water-ice mountain range bordering Sputnik Planitia.

name: Cthulhu Macula
origin: H. P. Lovecraft deity; vast dark reddish equatorial tholin province.

name: Mordor Macula
origin: Tolkien's dark land; reddish north-polar tholin cap cold-trapped from Pluto's atmosphere.

name: Serenity Chasma
origin: Firefly vessel; part of Charon's global extensional tectonic canyon belt.

name: Vulcan Planitia
origin: Star Trek planet; smooth southern cryovolcanic plains.

name: Cydonia Mensae
origin: Eroded mesa field along Mars's crustal dichotomy boundary; site of Viking 1's famous sun-angle shadow mesa.

name: Ben Guerir (UM6P / Space Camp)
origin: Rehamna Province, Morocco; Green Energy Park, UM6P, and NASA Space Apps Ben Guerir hub.

name: Erfoud / Anti-Atlas Mars Analog
origin: Tafilalt & Anti-Atlas, Morocco; hyper-arid Devonian-Cambrian desert used as a premier ESA/international Mars rover field testbed.

name: Noor Ouarzazate Solar Complex
origin: Drâa-Tafilalet, Morocco; 580 MW concentrated solar power (CSP) mirror array clearly visible from Earth observation satellites.

name: Richat Structure (Eye of the Sahara)
origin: Adrar Plateau, Mauritania; 40 km deeply eroded concentric alkaline geologic dome used as an orbital landmark since Gemini IV.

name: Nile River Delta
origin: Northern Egypt; classic arcuate fan delta directly analogous to ancient Martian lacustrine deltas such as Jezero Crater.
